question: A man spends 76% of his monthly salary on the rent of his house. If every month he also spends ₹627 on his conveyance and ₹3,947 on his grocery and saves the remaining ₹712, his monthly salary is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining percentage after rent = 100% − 76% = 24%

Total of other expenses and savings = 627 + 3947 + 712 = ₹5286

24% → ₹5286

100% → (5286 ÷ 24) × 100 = 220.25 × 100 = ₹22,025

**∴ The correct answer is ₹22,025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2484e78a1205607b10b0081c624b1506171b41c979e4b720a994f63bdc423393.png] 

**Given:**

**Rent Expenditure** = 76% of Salary

**Conveyance Expenditure** = ₹627

**Grocery Expenditure** = ₹3,947

**Monthly Savings** = ₹712

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total non-rent amount = Conveyance + Grocery + Savings

⇒ Total non-rent amount = 627 + 3947 + 712 = ₹5,286

⇒ Since Rent = 76%, Remaining amount percentage = 100% − 76% = 24%

⇒ 24% of Monthly Salary = ₹5,286

⇒ Monthly Salary = (5286 ÷ 24) × 100

⇒ Monthly Salary = 220.25 × 100 = ₹22,025

**∴ The correct answer is ₹22,025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Expenditure Formula

Income = Total Expenditure + Savings. Any component can be calculated if others are given.

Percentage Base Change

If a value is distributed into segments, the sum of all segment percentages must equal 100% of the base value.

Successive Percentage

If the problem states 'percentage of remaining', we use the formula: Final = Initial × (1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100).
